gen-fs-chubbo-gf-bree-serif: Chubbo draws every curve like a marker tip gliding without a snag. Bree Serif then adds oversized lowercase and a literary polish, a sturdier, more bookish voice against that casual line.
gen-fs-excon-gf-faustina: Faustina has bowls that thin gently and a jaw-wide c, with capitals barely above the lowercase. And beneath Excon's crowded, chalky headings, paragraphs of it would feel authoritative yet unhurried.
gen-fs-excon-gf-fragment-mono: Excon packs its letters together like chalk marks on a full slate, with towering lowercase and open terminals. Fragment Mono lines up beneath, spaced like nails on a ruler.
gen-fs-excon-gf-halant: Halant has a faint thick-thin shift and outward-pointing terminals. Excon's crowded chalk-mark headings sit comfortably above it, so a slightly larger size for Halant would let its subtle weight changes show.
gen-fs-excon-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Excon crowds its letters together like chalk marks on a full slate, with open terminals and no flared ends. Hedvig Letters Serif relaxes beneath it, its open-ended curves and gentle weight shifts giving the serif room to breathe.
gen-fs-excon-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC has the stature of cast iron capitals. Excon's bent-straw lines sit above it, crowded and friendly, while the serif's pulled-back terminals and moderate contrast keep everything dignified.
gen-fs-excon-gf-ovo: Ovo reads with a gentle nib-pressure swell, its thins barely lighter than its thicks. Under Excon's crowded headings, a page would feel settled and spacious.
gen-fs-new-title-dm-sans: DM Sans reads friendly and approachable, with wide-set terminals on its s. And a touch more size for it would help it hold its own against New Title's locked-together letters.
gen-fs-new-title-fs-literata: New Title links its letters together like a fine chain, with a lowercase that towers over its capitals. Literata answers softly, with modest thick-thin shifts and wide open curves.
gen-fs-new-title-fs-sentient: Bold and modern, New Title locks its letters like chain links. Sentient settles beneath it with pinched apertures and mellow stroke weights, a sophisticated, quieter voice.
